newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $4.3 bln for this week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $4.3 bln for this week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for this week are expected to total $4.3 billion in 160 deals, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $3.2 billion in 73 sales, the largest total this year, with a $275 million Detroit Sewer Authority, Mich., deal through PaineWebber Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 87 sales totaling $1.1 billion are scheduled. A $200 million Massachusettes Bay Transportation Authority deal on Wednesday is the largest.
An additional 12 sales totaling $383 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues this week depending on market conditions.
